## Appearance

Stella Maynard is characterized by her vivid appearance and black eyes. Beneath her striking look, she possesses a heart filled with wistful dreams and fancies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Stella Maynard is an ambitious and imaginative student at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Known as a "rose-red" girl, she possesses a thoughtful nature that leads her to form friendships with like-minded peers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), after which she worked as a schoolteacher. During Anne's second year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Stella proposed that she, [Anne](../character/anne.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) rent a house together for the following school year, bringing her [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) along to serve as housekeeper. The group, joined by [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), settled into Patty's Place, where Stella shared in the household's cozy student life, pet antics, and daily routine. Throughout their time living together, she participated in the housemates' literary pursuits and domestic life, including curing a rainy-day bout of melancholy with [Anne](../character/anne.md) by reading old stories written by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club). As their final college examinations finished, Stella and her friends reflected on their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and packed up their shared home as their college years came to a close.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P9](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P11](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P13](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Quotes

> "I love Anne and I like Roy. Everybody says she is making a brilliant match, and even Mrs. Gardner thinks her charming now. It all sounds as if it were made in heaven, but I have my doubts. Make the most of that, Aunt Jamesina."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Dawn P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)

> "I was afraid they’d come back. And then our jolly little nest here would be broken up—and we poor callow nestlings thrown out on the cruel world of boardinghouses again."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "Nothing seems worthwhile. My very thoughts are old. I’ve thought them all before. What is the use of living after all, Anne?"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

> "Oh, my mind agrees with you, Anne. But my soul remains doleful and uninspired. I’m always grubby and dingy on rainy nights."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)

> "Philippa Gordon! I never thought you were utterly unfeeling. The idea of you saying you’d love to break a man’s heart!"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Charming P20](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are intimate friends who first connected during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). [Anne](../character/anne.md) keeps in touch with Stella via letters detailing her life as a teacher, and later consults with her on major domestic arrangements, such as inviting [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) to live with them at Patty's Place. Together with their housemates and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), they share a cozy, comfortable home life marked by lively chats and shared routines.

- Friend of — intimate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), +3 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) formed a close bond as fellow students at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), sharing their academic anxieties and future hopes. They later live together at Patty's Place alongside other friends, decorating their home, handling pets, and supporting each other through college exams. Their companionship continues through their final year of university, sharing life's milestones and literary achievements until their college days end.

- Friend of — intimate friends and fellow students at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) belong to the same close circle of intimate friends originally formed at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Stella initiates a plan for the two of them and [Anne](../character/anne.md) to rent a home together with her [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) acting as housekeeper during their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). As housemates at Patty's Place, they study for exams, manage household life, and share in the joys and milestones of their group.

- Friend of — circle of intimate friends at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
